findings.message: The triangle list ends with an incomplete triangle: it has 10 vertex numbers, which is not a multiple of 3.
findings.hint: Give three vertex numbers for every triangle.

findings.message: Some triangles use vertex numbers that do not exist: the mesh has 5 vertices.
findings.hint: Vertex numbers start at 0 and must be lower than the number of vertices.

findings.message: Some triangles have no area: two corners are the same point, or all three are in a straight line.
findings.hint: Remove those triangles; they cannot be shaded.

findings.message: Some vertices are not used by any triangle.
findings.hint: They do no harm. Remove them if you do not need them.
